import math, random

def simulated_annealing(x={{x0}}, cost={{cost_fn}}, T={{T0}}, alpha={{alpha}}, iters={{iters}}):
    best = x; best_c = cost(x); cur_c = best_c
    for _ in range(iters):
        nx = [xi + random.gauss(0, T) for xi in x]
        nc = cost(nx)
        if nc < cur_c or random.random() < math.exp(-(nc - cur_c)/max(T, 1e-9)):
            x = nx; cur_c = nc
            if nc < best_c: best = nx; best_c = nc
        T *= alpha
    return best, best_c
